pawo.authentication: workspace service credential in X-PAWO-Service-Credential (docs/30 A-6)

assumptions: N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE stays at its secure default (true): no Code node reads process.env, and configuration is rendered into the artifacts at deploy time instead.
Webhook JWT authentication verifies the HS256 signature and expiry; the workflow additionally requires iat/exp, a lifetime of at most five minutes and a token bound to the envelope.
The Authorization header of a webhook request is redacted from execution data by the runtime; execution data is pruned by the deployment settings in n8n.env.example.
Waits below 65 seconds are held in process, so the retry loops need no external queue.
Credentials are referenced by id and name only; their values live in the n8n credential store.

credentials.name: PAWO Automation API
credentials.value: a workspace service credential from python -m pawo.automation.provision create

credentials.name: PAWO Webhook JWT
credentials.value: the shared webhook signing secret (at least 32 bytes)

operations.ANALYSIS: N8N-001, N8N-002 — one deterministic analysis per idempotency key
operations.INTERPRETATION: N8N-001 — one AI interpretation per setup
operations.ALERT_DELIVERY: N8N-003 — one setup notification per setup
operations.REPORT_DELIVERY: N8N-005 — one report per report date
operations.HEALTH_ALERT: N8N-002, N8N-006 and the error handler — one operational notification per bucket or execution
operations.OUTCOME_UPDATE: N8N-004 — one paper-trade entry per setup and one tick per trade and bar (Phase 9)

known_limitations: Paper trading is PAWO's: N8N-004 asks PAWO to advance each trade and computes no price, state or outcome. Its dependency branch reports the typed reason where paper trading is switched off.
No paper trade is created automatically: creation is an explicit call for a verified setup, and no workflow makes it.
The daily report carries no AI narrative: no verifier for report prose exists, and inventing statistics is forbidden.
Telegram is the only notification channel; email is documented in docs/15 but not implemented.
Rate limits and the retry state are per PAWO process and per n8n instance.
